snippet.title: STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl – Official PS5 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Developer GSC Game World has announced that  S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl will be released on PlayStation 5 and PS5 Pro in late 2025. The team says the PS5 version "will fully utilize DualSense controller features, including haptic feedback and adaptive triggers for deeper player immersion. Further technical enhancements for the PS5 Pro are also in development." STALKER 2 released to critical acclaim on PC and Xbox Series X|S last November, with IGN awarding the survival first-person shooter an 8 out of 10.
